readings.Aries: Bold moves suit you. Impulsive ones have a different outcome — know which this is. Small, deliberate, and patient — that's the mode today.
readings.Taurus: The change that's coming is smaller than your resistance to it suggests. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Gemini: Your ability to hold contradictions is genuinely rare. Today it's being tested by something simple. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Cancer: Something you're grieving is not the thing you think you're grieving. Look under it. Someone you haven't thought of lately is relevant to this.
readings.Leo: Your creativity needs an outlet or it will find one you didn't choose. Give it space. Make contact with the actual person rather than the version in your head.
readings.Virgo: You've been waiting for everything to be in place before you begin. It won't ever all be in place. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Libra: Your instinct for what looks and feels right is calibrated finely. Trust it on the bigger questions too. Something you've been measuring incorrectly just corrected itself.
readings.Scorpio: The secret you're keeping is protecting someone. Including, in some ways, yourself. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Sagittarius: You are more attached to the journey than to the destination, which is beautiful and occasionally inconvenient. Simpler is correct here.
readings.Capricorn: The legacy you're building is real. Make sure it looks the way you actually want it to look. The first instinct was right.
readings.Aquarius: Something you've classified as not your problem has been your problem the entire time. Saying less will move this further than saying more.
readings.Pisces: You dissolve into the spaces you inhabit. Make sure the space deserves you. The answer that feels too obvious is probably the actual answer.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
